parameters.name: local_filepath
parameters.description: local file path to get or put. (templated)

parameters.name: remote_filepath
parameters.description: remote file path to get or put. (templated)

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: specify operation 'get' or 'put', defaults to put

parameters.name: create_intermediate_dirs
parameters.description: create missing intermediate directories when copying from remote to local and vice-versa. Default is False. Example: The following task would copy ``file.txt`` to the remote host at ``/tmp/tmp1/tmp2/`` while creating ``tmp``,``tmp1`` and ``tmp2`` if they don't exist. If the ``create_intermediate_dirs`` parameter is not passed it would error as the directory does not exist. :: put_file = FTPFileTransmitOperator( task_id="test_ftp", ftp_conn_id="ftp_default", local_filepath="/tmp/file.txt", remote_filepath="/tmp/tmp1/tmp2/file.txt", operation="put", create_intermediate_dirs=True, dag=dag, )
